verdict.rationale: Ashby is an ATS, so per-role interview plans are a fair question for it. However, the evidence never documents interview plans, stage templates, question banks, or per-interviewer focus areas. The only nearby item is the generic marketing line about designing your recruiting process, which does not show this capability.

support.subject: As a recruiter, each role carries an interview plan — stages, question banks, and per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused
